test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lazy_join_facts (k UInt64, dim_key UInt32, other_key UInt32, ts UInt64, payload String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE lazy_join_dim (dim_key UInt32, name String, descr String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY dim_key
CREATE TABLE lazy_join_other (other_key UInt32, info String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY other_key
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lazy_join_facts SELECT number, number % 100000, number % 50000, cityHash64(number), repeat(randomPrintableASCII(25), 4) FROM numbers_mt(40000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_join_dim SELECT number * 2, concat('name_', toString(number * 2)), repeat(randomPrintableASCII(50), 4) FROM numbers_mt(50000)
INSERT INTO lazy_join_other SELECT number, repeat(randomPrintableASCII(50), 4) FROM numbers_mt(50000)
test.query: SELECT f.k, f.payload, d.name, d.descr FROM lazy_join_facts f JOIN lazy_join_dim d ON f.dim_key = d.dim_key ORDER BY f.ts LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
